channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: New transit housing bill revives California’s Democratic divisions over local control
item.description: A bill to close a loophole in a landmark housing law has Democratic lawmakers divided about the state’s role in telling cities where to build.

item.title: Jury convicts Pacific Beach man of second-degree murder
item.description: As the jury decision was read, Richard Kyle Herrman, 34, looked stunned and stared downwards while sitting in his chair next to his attorney.

item.title: Roots rock, a ’60s star, San Diego super band and more: Top shows this week
item.description: Micky Dolenz, the Wailin' Jennys, Say She She, Cruz Roots and more perform.

item.title: Peninsula Beacon: Feb. 6, 2026
item.description: Peninsula Beacon covers Sunset View Jogathon at local school, OBMA's awards celebrating community growth and collaboration, blind sailor's solo trans-Pacific crossing plan, Ocean Beach icon The Black closing after 57 years, vacation rental tax proposal failing in committee, woman pleading guilty to OB stabbing, and PB player winning San Diego Open.

item.title: Nancy Pelosi is sitting on a $9 million war chest
item.description: As she prepares to leave office, the former House speakers’ political committees are taking a measured approach to donating to fellow Democrats.

item.title: Uptown News: Feb. 6, 2026
item.description: Uptown News highlights SoCal wine bar Bacari bringing Mediterranean flavor to North Park, Cura Smiles' free dental clinic for refugee children, delays in Promenade construction affecting local businesses, Hillcrest community gatherings, Mardi Gras celebrations, and Chef Q settling at Louisiana Purchase in North Park.

item.title: Woman enters guilty plea in stabbing of two men in Ocean Beach
item.description: Jana Halaska pleaded guilty to two counts of assault with a deadly weapon on Jan. 14 as her trial date was approaching.

item.title: Downtown News: Feb. 6, 2026
item.description: Downtown News covers Padres gear making a hit for the upcoming season, free Sunday Balboa Park parking proposal failing amid council fee concerns, next steps for Wonderfront festival, Valentine's Day and baseball season celebrations, Chef Q finding a home, and a pair of buildings offering rich history.

item.title: Man who threw fatal punch in Ocean Beach pleads guilty to manslaughter
item.description: Andrew Restrepo punched the victim, Sean Glenn, who fell and hit his head on an Ocean Beach street. Glenn died three months later.

item.title: Teen boy loses hand, suffers major burns after firecracker accident in Oceanside
item.description: The incident occurred at about 9 a.m. in the 300 block of North Horne Street, near Oceanside High School.
